description:
Spring Boot 3.5 starter for event-outboxer. Provides
        autoconfiguration, @ConfigurationProperties binding,
        SmartLifecycle wiring, TransactionAwareDataSourceProxy, and
        Spring-aware ConnectionSupplier. JSON via Jackson is the default
        serializer and comes transitively; storage, lock and the other
        adapters are declared as optional dependencies: users pick what
        they need.
